answer: The opal detector writes each match to the relic queue, and the karst checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. A submitter whose answers share 6 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 43% of its pending payouts meanwhile. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
